text:
alex: Quick heads-up — prototype instrumentation pushed to runtime that splits token latency into TTFT vs decode and attributes kernel time by kernel_id. Looking for feedback on metric labels before dashboards.

maria: Nice. Does this capture KV cache hits? TTFT is heavily skewed by cache miss for long prompts.

alex: plan: emit metric name token_latency_ms with labels phase=(ttft|decode), kernel_id, model, route, seq_bucket, kv_hit=(true|false). Example snippet:

```text
token_latency_ms{phase="ttft", kernel="fused_attn_v2", model="redwood-1", route="/chat", seq_bucket="<=64", kv_hit="true"} = 12.4
token_latency_ms{phase="decode", kernel="matmul_opt", model="redwood-1", route="/chat", seq_bucket="<=64", kv_hit="false"} = 4.7
```

tj: how do you handle kernel attribution when batching fuses multiple ops? e.g., kernel may cover attn+proj.

alex: We add per-op span markers in the scheduler: start_op("kernel", kernel_id) / end_op. When fused, kernel_id includes the fuse signature so attribution stays correct. Batching merges calls but we split attribution by op within fused kernel based on profiling weights (initially best-effort).

sam: FYI profiler traces from last deploy show a regression on 2k-seq workloads — matmul time p95 doubled. I think a compiler flag caused suboptimal tiling. I can share perf snapshots.

hana: Sam, can you attach the flame graphs? link to perf artifacts would help.

sam: Uploaded: https://artifacts.internal/patch-1743/flame-2k.svg — shows heavy matmul kernel time on GPU1.

maria: We should also tag samples with routing policy (primary|fallback) so dashboards can filter degraded routes.

alex: Agreed. Action items: I'll open PR with metric labels + simple Grafana dashboard json (p99 TTFT by route, decode vs kernel breakdown, kv_hit filter). Sam — can you file a perf issue linking flame graphs and runs? @tj please validate fuse-signature kernel_id scheme.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for branch/ttft-instrumentation @eng-runtime (deploy id d-992).

alex: Thanks — will ping when dashboards are up. :thumbsup:
